title: COMMANDING THE
BLESSING UPON YOU
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: warm morning light on wheat field
open wooden door to garden path
soft focus sunlight through stone archway

scenes.a: As you stand before this difficult financial crossroads, know that God sees every hidden need.
Hear the promise of the Lord for your work and the labor of your hands.
The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
Father, we surrender our storehouses and the work we do daily into Your sovereign hands.
Grant us the wisdom to manage what You have entrusted to our care this season.
May Your provision manifest in our lives as we walk in faithful obedience today. Amen.
